title: Privacy
paragraphs: We do not sell your information. Audit requests (URL, traffic, email, bottleneck) are used to reply to you and to decide if we are the right lab. That is it.
This site does not run advertising pixels. If we add analytics later, it will be first-party and documented here — not slipped in as consent theatre.
